name: Chip
use: use for a workflow state on a list row: Awaiting, Active, Done, Late, Overdue, Sow died (one per row, under the ID).
notUse: not for a recorded health condition — use ConditionTag; not for a forecast like "Due tomorrow" — that is row text.

name: Word
use: use for a state said inline in a heading, a meta line or a map cell: a 4px dot and the word (the pen map uses it).
notUse: not for a state on a list row — use the chip; not for a coloured value inside a sentence — use the line.

name: Line
use: use for a body line whose values carry the colour: a receipt, an overdue figure, a row's mono line 2.
notUse: not for a state word on its own — use the word or the chip.
